reviews.text:
Nice people! They help you through the entire process and will answer any question you have! We started in October and were sitting in the hot tub Christmas morning! Pool is gorgeous! Highly recommend.
-Jordyn and Sean Kramer
Trophy Club

Gary started us off and met several times with us to be sure we were getting what we wanted.  Next Kurtis the construction supervisor was super attentive and let me ask him a million questions at each step, thank you Kurtis! Top notch team doing top notch work for a reasonable cost.  Thank you team!

We had leak repair and replaster done. Everything had been great, until the job was completely finished. DFW plaster people removed the Polaris cleaner fitting from the wall, and plastered over it. We realized it the very next day. It has been over a month and they have not returned to fix the situation. It took them 2 weeks just to call us back. It's fall and we have so many leaves and acorns falling into the pool that the net and pole will just not pick up. Very disappointed in the customer se

We recently had our pool completed by DFW Custom Pools, and while the end result is beautiful, I unfortunately can’t give them 5 stars.

The beginning of the process was great — communication was strong and things seemed promising. However, that consistency didn’t last throughout the build. Our project supervisor was responsive when I reached out, but I constantly had to text for updates and next steps rather than being kept informed proactively.

We chose to go with pavers, and if we could go b

I hired DFW Custom Pools to resurface my pool, replace my filter, and rewire my light switch. After the resurface, there's a large scratch and chip on a corner of the plaster. The guy never looked at the light switch. Now the light in the pool won't stay in and I have an air leak coming from the return. Also they put a water port where they were supposed to put a vacuum port back in. They also won't return text on when they're coming back to fix these issues and also haven't redone the mastic. T

After hiring and entering into a contract with another pool company and the frustration of waiting for months almost a year for them to start building our dream pool, I went out to seek another pool company and found DFW Customer Pool. Not only was I able to reach out to them and answering on a Saturday, but I was able to explain my frustration to the owner who was very down to Earth and understanding. He advised me that if I was able to get the city permit transferred to their company they woul

I can't express how grateful I am for the incredible work done by DFW Custom Pools. They brought my vision to life with professionalism and skill. Every question I had was met with patience and expertise. The result is beautiful and exceeds my expectations. Highly recommended for anyone looking for quality and dedication.

I called them on Friday to get a quote for putting on a freeze guard before the weather got cold again. They gave me a reasonable price so I went with them and they came out the same day did the work quickly. They are professional and get the work done. I am very happy and will use them for other work.

We recently had a pool designed and build with this pool builder everything was perfect until I started having issues with my pool leaking. This company does not take accountability in their work when things go wrong. It’s been months and no one will return my call or access the issue. I advise choosing another company.
From the tile alignment to the perfectly leveled deck, their craftsmanship is impeccable. They treated our backyard like it was their own. A+ workmanship!

Very good team and communicates well. I have spoken to owner a couple times and he is very friendly, honest and quick to respond to issues. Our pool is beautiful and was completed on time. Designer was great and made quick revisions and sent them back right away. The whole team handled building a pool in a difficult town with strict permitting. Very happy with the results.
Our cracked concrete deck was replaced with beautiful pavers, and the difference is night and day. The crew was efficient and left no debris behind. Looks like a million bucks!

From start to finish the team built the pool of our dreams!  Most importantly, Kurtis and his communication with us as the customer. The best and this company will listen to you unlike the rest of them.
Great experience from start to finish. They stayed on budget, kept us updated regularly, and cleaned up after every workday. The pool turned out just like the 3D renderings
The crew was professional, on time, and kept our yard clean throughout the build. Now we’ve got a beautiful backyard oasis we use almost every day.
We needed a quick replaster before a family reunion, and they got it done in record time. No mess left behind, and the finish is flawless. Will call them for any future work!
We had a tight schedule and were nervous about delays, but the team stayed right on track. They kept the project organized and stress-free. Everything came together just the way we wanted.
No hidden fees or surprise charges, just honest, upfront quotes. They stuck to the estimate and delivered exceptional quality. Refreshing to work with professionals!

DFW custom pools knocked it out of the ballpark! My pool was ever 20 years old and needed to be resurfaced, new coping, added onto the steps and an in-line chlorinator. I got five bids on it and they were close to the least expensive but more importantly they did quality work and delivered what they promised they would do in the time that they promised they could do it! I was blown away highly highly recommend!
With little kids, we wanted a pool fence and non-slip surfaces. They installed everything securely and stylishly. Peace of mind + great aesthetics!

reviews.text: Wade with DFW Pool Services was very professional as well as very helpful and knowledgeable when we found ourselves having to have our pool totally remodeled. We were kept informed every step of the way so we felt like we were part of the process. We are very satisfied with our new pool and love it! Wade also worked with us on the financial end of having a pool remodeled and we ended up paying thousands less than what was quoted to us by another pool company in the Dallas area. Thank you DFW Pool Services!  Kim Gomez
reviews.author: Kim Gomez

reviews.text: Great renovation work on our pool. They changed the profile of our spa and replaced all the glass tile.  Also cleaned all the glass tile around the pool and sealed our coping.  These guys are very professional and courteous. They also stay on schedule.  Thanks for a great job for us.
reviews.author: Brian Edwards

reviews.text: Wade and his team helped us bring our pool back to life. We were able to get a sparkling pool finish that we can enjoy for years. They helped the entire way through the process and communicated well when workers would be coming to our home. If you are looking for a company to renovate your pool they are hands down the best.
reviews.author: Norma Meyers

reviews.text:
This is a great company. We switch from another company we had been with for almost 10 years. Previous company was outlandish with cost for repairs and it seemed every 6 months prices were going up.

DFW guaranteed us our price would stay the same. The service they offer is better than most. Techs do a great job.
reviews.author: John Gage

reviews.text:
We had DFW Pool Service work on multiple smaller maintenance projects on our pool for a house we recently bought in Corinth, TX. I have to say hands down what a great company and crew to work with.

They have been available for all sorts of questions and call backs walking us through every step of the process. From pump and plumping updates to stone work the product has been top notch!

Definitely will use again when needed!
reviews.author: Kimberly Deluca

reviews.text: I had mastic and LED pool lights installed. DFW Pool’s team did a great job. They were very professional and extremely helpful. I could not be more pleased with the quality of work. I highly recommend this company.
reviews.author: Randy House

reviews.text: DFW Pool Services did an excellent job cleaning and servicing my pool.  The service was prompt and the work was excellent.  Appointments were generally adhered to and if they were running a little behind, they kept me in the loop as the customer through text messages.  The service technician also made me aware of other work that I needed which I probably wouldn't have noticed until it was too late.  Estimates were provided and accurate and service was timely.  If necessary, the owner will step up and handle any situation that might arise and work to achieve your satisfaction as the customer.  I highly recommend DFW Pool Services to anyone in the metro area needing pool service.
reviews.author: John Ramirez

reviews.text: Outstanding work on our spa renovation.  Aldo cleaned all our glass tile and coping.  It looks great!!  Wade and Cameron were very professional and thorough.
reviews.author: Carrie Edwards

Nice people! They help you through the entire process and will answer any question you have! We started in October and were sitting in the hot tub Christmas morning! Pool is gorgeous! Highly recommend.
-Jordyn and Sean Kramer
Trophy Club

Gary started us off and met several times with us to be sure we were getting what we wanted.  Next Kurtis the construction supervisor was super attentive and let me ask him a million questions at each step, thank you Kurtis! Top notch team doing top notch work for a reasonable cost.  Thank you team!

We had leak repair and replaster done. Everything had been great, until the job was completely finished. DFW plaster people removed the Polaris cleaner fitting from the wall, and plastered over it. We realized it the very next day. It has been over a month and they have not returned to fix the situation. It took them 2 weeks just to call us back. It's fall and we have so many leaves and acorns falling into the pool that the net and pole will just not pick up. Very disappointed in the customer se

We recently had our pool completed by DFW Custom Pools, and while the end result is beautiful, I unfortunately can’t give them 5 stars.

The beginning of the process was great — communication was strong and things seemed promising. However, that consistency didn’t last throughout the build. Our project supervisor was responsive when I reached out, but I constantly had to text for updates and next steps rather than being kept informed proactively.

We chose to go with pavers, and if we could go b

I hired DFW Custom Pools to resurface my pool, replace my filter, and rewire my light switch. After the resurface, there's a large scratch and chip on a corner of the plaster. The guy never looked at the light switch. Now the light in the pool won't stay in and I have an air leak coming from the return. Also they put a water port where they were supposed to put a vacuum port back in. They also won't return text on when they're coming back to fix these issues and also haven't redone the mastic. T

After hiring and entering into a contract with another pool company and the frustration of waiting for months almost a year for them to start building our dream pool, I went out to seek another pool company and found DFW Customer Pool. Not only was I able to reach out to them and answering on a Saturday, but I was able to explain my frustration to the owner who was very down to Earth and understanding. He advised me that if I was able to get the city permit transferred to their company they woul

I can't express how grateful I am for the incredible work done by DFW Custom Pools. They brought my vision to life with professionalism and skill. Every question I had was met with patience and expertise. The result is beautiful and exceeds my expectations. Highly recommended for anyone looking for quality and dedication.

I called them on Friday to get a quote for putting on a freeze guard before the weather got cold again. They gave me a reasonable price so I went with them and they came out the same day did the work quickly. They are professional and get the work done. I am very happy and will use them for other work.

We recently had a pool designed and build with this pool builder everything was perfect until I started having issues with my pool leaking. This company does not take accountability in their work when things go wrong. It’s been months and no one will return my call or access the issue. I advise choosing another company.
From the tile alignment to the perfectly leveled deck, their craftsmanship is impeccable. They treated our backyard like it was their own. A+ workmanship!

Very good team and communicates well. I have spoken to owner a couple times and he is very friendly, honest and quick to respond to issues. Our pool is beautiful and was completed on time. Designer was great and made quick revisions and sent them back right away. The whole team handled building a pool in a difficult town with strict permitting. Very happy with the results.
Our cracked concrete deck was replaced with beautiful pavers, and the difference is night and day. The crew was efficient and left no debris behind. Looks like a million bucks!

From start to finish the team built the pool of our dreams!  Most importantly, Kurtis and his communication with us as the customer. The best and this company will listen to you unlike the rest of them.
Great experience from start to finish. They stayed on budget, kept us updated regularly, and cleaned up after every workday. The pool turned out just like the 3D renderings
The crew was professional, on time, and kept our yard clean throughout the build. Now we’ve got a beautiful backyard oasis we use almost every day.
We needed a quick replaster before a family reunion, and they got it done in record time. No mess left behind, and the finish is flawless. Will call them for any future work!
We had a tight schedule and were nervous about delays, but the team stayed right on track. They kept the project organized and stress-free. Everything came together just the way we wanted.
No hidden fees or surprise charges, just honest, upfront quotes. They stuck to the estimate and delivered exceptional quality. Refreshing to work with professionals!

DFW custom pools knocked it out of the ballpark! My pool was ever 20 years old and needed to be resurfaced, new coping, added onto the steps and an in-line chlorinator. I got five bids on it and they were close to the least expensive but more importantly they did quality work and delivered what they promised they would do in the time that they promised they could do it! I was blown away highly highly recommend!
With little kids, we wanted a pool fence and non-slip surfaces. They installed everything securely and stylishly. Peace of mind + great aesthetics!

data.summary: The majority of reviews, especially on the local page, appear authentic and detail positive experiences with specific crews and projects. However, a clear and credible pattern emerges from negative reviews: the company has significant issues with post-completion customer service, warranty follow-through, and communication once final payment is received. The positive reviews are likely real but reflect the initial project phase, while the negative reviews reveal a failure in the final quality assurance and support phase.
fake_signals: Some 5-star reviews on HQ page use generic, corporate-sounding praise (e.g., 'brought my vision to life')
Multiple anonymous 5-star reviews on HQ page lack specific details

negative_evidence: Multiple 1-2 star reviews explicitly state the company failed to return to fix defects (plastered-over fitting, scratched plaster, air leak, wrong port).
Complaints cite ignored calls/texts and lack of accountability for leaks and other issues.
positive_evidence: Positive reviews imply good service and communication during the project.

authentic_signals: Local reviews mention specific employees (Wade, Cameron, Aldo, Kurtis, Gary)
Local reviews describe specific projects (spa renovation, tile cleaning, mastic installation, pump updates)
1- and 2-star complaints provide highly specific, credible details (plastered-over fitting, scratched plaster, wrong port installed)
Writing styles and perspectives vary significantly between reviews
Mix of glowing praise and detailed criticism indicates authentic customer feedback
complaint_patterns: Poor communication after job is done
Failure to return and fix defects
data.discrepancy_explanation: High Google rating is supported by an A+ BBB rating and accreditation. No contradictory low ratings from other major platforms were found.
